name: Tammy Jundt
prior_offices: Crook County treasurer (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Tammy Jundt is the Crook County treasurer and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official elected officials page lists her in that office, and the official general election summary lists her as the winner of the treasurer race.

sources.name: Crook County official 2026 general election summary
